mechanism: Lisdexamfetamine (a prodrug of amphetamine) may potentiate dopaminergic activity, while aripiprazole acts as a dopamine D2 partial agonist, creating potential CNS stimulation and reducing antipsychotic efficacy.
action: Monitor for reduced antipsychotic efficacy and increased CNS stimulation; use combination cautiously in ADHD patients requiring antipsychotics, with dose adjustments as needed.
